aggregates.schematicConnectivityEncoding: nets sorted by name; each record is name + NUL + membership SHA-256 + NUL + topology-evidence SHA-256 + LF

capture.method: KiCad canonical netlist plus normalized native schematic objects
capture.verificationScope: Repository verification checks this normalized capture and its comparison closure; it does not re-run KiCad or read the omitted source.

discrepancies.detail: The USB-C footprint has unconnected A8 and B8 SBU pads, while the captured USB2-only schematic symbol has no corresponding pins.

waivers.justification: A8 and B8 are USB-C SBU contacts intentionally unused by this USB2 design; both PCB pads are unconnected and the schematic symbol deliberately omits them.
